content_sections.heading: RPCAU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the RPCAU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download RPCAU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Test Engineer : M. Tech. in Farm Machinery and Power Engineering. Candidate with experience of working in reputed Farm Machinery Training and Testing Centre is desirable. Senior Research Fellow (SRF) : M. Tech. in Farm Machinery and Power Engineering with 4 years B. Tech. in Agricultural Engineering. Candidate with experience of operation & Testing of Farm Machines is desirable.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RPCAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University (RPCAU), located in Pusa, Samastipur, Bihar, for temporary research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this RPCAU notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites eligible candidates for the positions of Test Engineer and Senior Research Fellow (SRF) under temporary project frameworks.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 post allocated for Test Engineer and 1 post allocated for Senior Research Fellow (SRF).

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for RPCAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Candidates do not need to send applications online or offline in advance unless specified; they must attend directly.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the announced positions is scheduled to be held on 06-10-2026 at the Directorate of Research (DoR), RPCAU, Pusa, Samastipur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Test Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Test Engineer post must possess an M. Tech. degree in Farm Machinery and Power Engineering from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification needed for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: Applicants for the SRF post need an M. Tech. in Farm Machinery and Power Engineering along with a 4-year B. Tech. degree in Agricultural Engineering.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The Test Engineer receives a fixed salary of ₹ 45,000/- per month, whereas the Senior Research Fellow receives ₹ 37,000/- per month plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for the Test Engineer post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Test Engineer position ranges from a minimum of 21 years to a maximum of 45 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled application form, original and self-attested photocopies of educational and experience certificates, ID proof, and 5 copies of an updated CV.
